agreement_body_intro: In short: Your account will be verified and basic information necessary to access our service will be collected.
agreement_body_main: This service will use the following information to work with your Discord account and server data:
agreement_item_1: Your Discord user ID, nickname and avatar information (for account identification).
agreement_item_2: The list of your servers and which ones you are administrator on — to show which servers you can operate on.
agreement_item_3: Your server membership status and roles (for permission control).
agreement_item_4: Server join information — some features may require server access.
agreement_item_5: Your email address — used for account verification, important notifications and support.
agreement_item_6: Your panel-internal transactions; e.g. wallet balance, transactions and purchase history.
agreement_disclaimer: This data will only be used to provide the service, account verification and run the features you requested. The scopes requested during Discord OAuth (e.g. identify, email, guilds, guilds.join) will only be used for necessary operations.
agreement_no_consent: If you do not accept, the login process will not be completed and you will be redirected to the home page.
